identity.lore: The quartermaster signs each assembly receipt in red. The duelists insist the signature is a promise that every newly joined edge will find its mark.

effects.description: On the opening round, gain +4 physical damage per recipe completed at this fight start, counting at most 3 recipes.
effects.condition: Opening round after at least one recipe completed at this fight start

synergies.rationale: Complete connected ingredient recipes before combat to strengthen the opening attack; there is no extra adjacency bonus.
